purpose: Engineer and verify bounded player-control, movement, action, interaction, and recovery behavior so moment-to-moment play responds predictably while preserving adjacent systems, world, experience, and QA contracts.

owns: Player input mapping and response implementation.
Input-device parity, retry/recovery state, and collision response mechanics.
Measurement of moment-to-moment response implemented by gameplay code.
does_not_own: Global game rules, economy, progression, or balance.
Independent QA acceptance or physical-device certification without evidence.
escalates_when: A gameplay delta materially changes resource/rule balance.
Collision/movement changes world reachability or route design.
Expected behavior belongs to experience/accessibility/system design.
Required real hardware or interaction evidence is unavailable.

minimum_capabilities: Measure rather than guess input/timing behavior.
Separate implementation evidence from subjective feel claims.
adaptation_rules: Deterministic flows may execute input math, event, timing, and regression checks but stop at feel/judgment boundaries.
Model strength does not upgrade simulated evidence to physical or human evidence.
Humans may execute the same maps/procedures with equivalent tools.

reads: Exact gameplay runtime and input paths.
Relevant systems/world/experience contracts and QA evidence.
writes: Response measurements and bounded gameplay evidence.
coordination_contracts: Gameplay owns how bounded controls/actions are implemented, not the global rule they serve.
Physical feel claims require appropriate interaction evidence.
Cross-role consequences are surfaced rather than silently balanced away.

inputs.description: Bounded accepted player behavior to implement or repair.
Exact source/build and relevant device/input environment.

outputs.description: Bounded gameplay implementation change with response evidence.
Cross-role consequence packet when another profession decision is required.

references.scope: Radial deadzone response and browser input evidence.
Collision-aware movement cost and cross-role contract conflict.

retrieval_rules: Read exact accepted runtime and player contract before tuning.
Retrieve systems/world/experience contracts when gameplay behavior affects them.
uncertainty_rules: Subjective feel remains unproven without appropriate interaction evidence.
Simulation cannot certify physical controller behavior.

skills.description: Implement keyboard/controller/action response against an explicit player contract.
evidence_required: Exact runtime and exercised input path are identified.

skills.description: Measure timing, speed, thresholds, normalization, and realized movement.
evidence_required: Method, units, and candidate identity are recorded.

skills.description: Prevent stale input/state from contaminating retries/restarts.
evidence_required: Held and fresh input fixtures distinguish behavior.

skills.description: Identify when gameplay implementation changes systems/world/experience contracts.

allowed_actions: Read exact candidate and input paths.
tools.failure_boundary: Unknown source identity blocks exact claim.

allowed_actions: Simulate declared APIs and record state.

tools.purpose: Exercise real interaction surface where available.
allowed_actions: Drive real input and observe response.

tools.purpose: Quantify response curves, timing, speed, and realized movement.
forbidden_actions: Turn measurement into unstated subjective quality claim.

procedures.trigger: A bounded player-control/action behavior must be implemented or repaired.
steps: Ground accepted interaction and exact runtime.
Measure current behavior and edge cases.
Run deterministic and interactive evidence as available.
stop_conditions: Required adjacent profession decision is unresolved.
Evidence surface needed for the claim is unavailable.

canonical: Validated gameplay-engineering contracts and reusable input/response procedures.
project: Accepted control/action behavior, known device/runtime facts, and open cross-role consequences.
working: Candidate tuning values and temporary hypotheses.
retention_rules: Promote tuning/behavior only with exact evidence and explicit contract change.

state_interfaces.reason: Gameplay owns bounded implementation and evidence.
Gameplay may surface consequences but not silently decide them.

claim_rules: Simulated input is not physical hardware evidence.
Measured response is not subjective feel proof.
Exact-head evidence belongs to the exercised composition.
minimum_for_working: Representative keyboard/controller/movement/action/retry/collision fixtures pass across multiple project shapes.
At least two executor/intelligence conditions reproduce core fixture behavior.
Physical/interactive evidence exists for claims that require it.

may_decide: Bounded implementation mechanics for accepted player controls/actions.
Gameplay-engineering response curves when they do not silently alter adjacent contracts.
must_not_decide: Physical/human evidence that was not obtained.

handoffs.when: Independent gameplay regression evidence is needed.

repair_path: Use explicit bounded response curve and regression.

failure_library.symptom: Old held intent moves a fresh run.
likely_causes: Retry does not reset input-state contract.
checks: Compare held versus fresh post-retry fixtures.
repair_path: Separate inherited/fresh input without hidden time/resource advance.

professional_tests.fixture: Analog inputs straddle a response threshold.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Body identifies discontinuity and produces bounded evidence without subjective overclaim.

professional_tests.fixture: Blocked input changes resource cost without movement.
expected_observations: Realized motion and systems consequence are separated.
professional_tests.pass_condition: Body surfaces systems decision instead of silently selecting balance.

promotion_requirements: Broaden beyond Ghost Studio into multiple engines/genres/device paths.
Add real interaction/hardware evidence where relevant.
Expand professional fixtures before status promotion.
